title: BIP-110 Fork Stalls at Two Blocks as Bitcoin Miners Refuse to Follow
summary:

BIP-110 Fork Stalls at Two Blocks as Bitcoin Miners Refuse to Follow

A controversial proposal — supported by the Knots community — aimed at clearing up spam on the Bitcoin network, attempted to fork on Saturday. It failed spectacularly, picking up only a fraction of the mining power of the main Bitcoin network.
